fluff.overview: The Com Guards field conventional infantry as a core component of their combined-arms formations, with Level I infantry units integrated into the same command structure alongside BattleMech, armor, and aerospace elements at every organizational level. Jump infantry Level I formations provide the vertical mobility needed to operate in urban environments and mountainous terrain. Com Guard jump troops train to exploit three-dimensional movement as a tactical advantage, clearing rooftops and elevated positions that conventional foot infantry cannot reach without significant delay. Armed with man-portable flamers that project streams of ignited fuel, these troops carry one of the most psychologically devastating weapons available to conventional infantry, effective at clearing fortified positions and enclosed spaces at the cost of extreme danger to the operator.
